title: Build the yaml-lsp plugin in opum-ai/yaml-lsp with a passing plugin eval and a release tag (OPAG-960 AC3, DEC-109)
description: DEC-109 (operator, 2026-10-01, relayed by opum-doc as ODOC-OP-2026-10-01-15 via opum-agent; read first-party from opum-agent planning.json at 6505e154): opum-marketplace is the fleet worker for public skills and plugins repos, and owns opum-ai/yaml-lsp including the OPAG-960 AC3 build, its eval and the tag pin. The plugin is built in opum-ai/yaml-lsp (public, created by the operator under DEC-87 B) following the official -lsp pattern measured in the OMARK-79 notes: the yaml-language-server with --stdio, mapping .yaml and .yml to languageId yaml. Scope here is the plugin content, the eval suite, and the release tag. The marketplace federation is OMARK-79 and resumes once the tag exists. yaml-lsp has no CI or branch ruleset yet (DEC-109 open questions), so delivery there is a branch and PR then squash merge into dev, with no checks configured.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The plugin is committed to opum-ai/yaml-lsp in the repo-root layout (.claude-plugin/plugin.json, README.md, LICENSE) and the yaml-language-server config (.yaml and .yml mapping to yaml) is present where an installed plugin reads it, the placement measured on this machine rather than assumed.
The plugin reached yaml-lsp dev by pull request and squash merge with no direct commits, and the release tag v0.1.0 is pushed with plugin.json at the tag declaring version 0.1.0.
The eval suite under evals/ runs green via claude plugin eval against the tagged content, with the command run, claude version, and result recorded on this task.

implementationNotes: Delivered and verified 2026-10-01. Placement question settled by measurement on claude 2.1.286: with a plugin.json present, an entry-level lspServers copy is inert, so the config lives in the manifest; confirmed by a live install from an entry carrying no inline config, whose component inventory reads: LSP servers (1) yaml-language-server. Build delivered by PR opum-ai/yaml-lsp#1 (squash 887535a54b6dce4aa0750a72fd947ac31ccc4a6a); annotated release tag v0.1.0 (tag object 02dc66c66a2fc8d58d6f090c011ef55909bcfb12) pushed; plugin.json at the tag declares version 0.1.0, verified through the pin checker's own raw URL. Eval evidence: claude plugin eval . --runs 3 --trust-plugin --no-publish --allow-tools Write Read LSP, run from the repository root, exit 0; case lsp-tool-answers-for-yaml with-arm 1.00 (3 of 3 runs), no-plugin arm 0.00 (3 of 3), delta 1.00, partial false; recorded in evals/BASELINE.md. The suite grades a real LSP tool round-trip against yaml-language-server, and the no-plugin arm has no LSP tool at all, so the delta is a plugin-fired signal rather than a wording difference. Also closed the notes' last unmeasured question: a github-source install of the entry's exact shape registers the server. The marketplace federation of this plugin is OMARK-79 (opum-ai/opum-marketplace#190).
finalSummary: Built the yaml-lsp plugin in opum-ai/yaml-lsp and cut v0.1.0. PR opum-ai/yaml-lsp#1 merged (squash 887535a54b6dce4aa0750a72fd947ac31ccc4a6a); annotated tag v0.1.0 pushed; plugin.json at the tag declares version 0.1.0. The lspServers placement question was settled by measurement on claude 2.1.286 (the manifest is the manifest; entry-level copies are inert), confirmed by a live install and component inventory: LSP servers (1) yaml-language-server. Eval: claude plugin eval against the tagged content exits 0, with-arm 1.00 and no-plugin arm 0.00 across 3 of 3 runs each (delta 1.00), recorded in evals/BASELINE.md and in this task's notes. Federation of the entry delivered under OMARK-79 via opum-ai/opum-marketplace#190.
